steps.content: When you push open the door, Lynn is spacing out, head bowed.
Seeing the visitor, the girl curls up more into the chair, the heavy helmet on her head threatening to crush her slender frame.
You guys turned the DisCars upside down together just a while ago. You've long discovered she's a Sinner.
After bringing her back to the Bureau, you immediately asked Nightingale to look into this Sinner who called herself the Cyclops. As expected, you found that she was related to a campus incident.

The terminal is showing a slightly stuttering video recording. In it, a blonde girl is escaping from the crime scene while covering her eyes.
Her outfit and the hair clip on the ends of her hair indicate that this is the same Sinner sitting in the interrogation room awaiting to be questioned. Lynn.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The Eastside School Incident is the most discussed campus case in recent years. With a lot of controversy surrounding it, the case still remains unsolved today.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Legend has it that the culprit of the case is the Eastside Cyclops whose modus operandi is extremely vile and scandalous.
You know that's Lynn's nickname, but recalling the time you've spent together, you don't believe she will hurt someone intentionally.
You suspect there's something more behind the case. Lynn may not be the initiator. Even if she was, you want to know why she did that.
It's been a while, Lynn. Have you gotten used to life in the Bureau?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I, I'm fine... Thanks for asking... Chief.
It's almost impossible to link this timid and skittish girl here to that ruthless and fearsome Cyclops in the rumors.

But to find out the truth, you must extract more detailed information from her, especially that about this gigantic helmet you're looking at. Lynn wasn't wearing it when she escaped from the crime scene.
Seeing Lynn curled up in the seat, you can't bring yourself to be too harsh, so you're taking a more tactful approach.
No need to be nervous. I'm just here to have a chat.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Hmm... Sure...
Though Lynn nods to agree, she still seems sheepish, which makes you sigh.
These little accessories you're wearing, did you make them yourself?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: ...Eh? Y-Yes!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Is... Is there something wrong with them...?
Not at all. I just find them... um, very cute.
You seem pretty handy.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Oh... Thank you...
Your compliment makes Lynn shy, but she seems less uncomfortable now. Looks like you've found a good icebreaker.
You probably designed those ruffles on your clothes too, right? They're so dainty!
And the toy charm on the camera too. It's tiny, but the details are amazing.
You're really talented.
Dazzled by the series of compliments, Lynn seems completely tongue-tied now.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Th... Thank you! Chief... is talented... in observing things too...
steps.female_content: Th... Thank you! Chief... is talented too... for having observed so many details...

steps.content: I can tell you have a real passion for these cute little accessories. Is this a trend among high schoolers these days? Reminds me of my school days...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I... I guess...
I'll introduce you to Summer. I'm sure she'd love to hear about these popular trends among high school girls.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Really...?
Yeah. And, she loves the extraordinary look of characters in anime. She'll be interested in you since you wear such a special helmet.
The two of you may become good friends.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: What?! My, my helmet...
At the mention of the helmet, Lynn's whole body freezes and her tone becomes nervous.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: This... This is just a regular helmet, there's nothing special about it...
I see...
I hear from Nightingale and the Sinners that you never take off your helmet.
If it doesn't have any special uses, then can I ask why you won't take it off? It looks kinda heavy, I imagine it's not too comfortable wearing it all day.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Can't take it off!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Never... Never! If I take it off... something horrible will happen!
You can't make out Lynn's face behind the helmet, but you still recognize the fear and trepidation in her quivering voice.
It's okay, I'm not going to take it off... I won't force you, Lynn.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Mmm...
You now belong to the Bureau, Lynn. Without my orders, no one can touch you. I'll protect you from that horrible thing you mentioned too.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: You... You'll protect me?
Lynn asks warily with some disbelief.
Yes, that's my job.
If the time we spent together in Dillywood proves that I'm a trustworthy person... I hope you could tell me what actually happened.
I'll protect you. I'll stop these horrible things from getting close to you, or prevent them from happening at all.
But... I'll need you to be honest with me, so I know how to help you.
Lynn bows her head even lower.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: ...Do you really want to know?
Seeing you nod, the girl takes a few deep breaths before she begins stutteringly.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: They... They forced the helmet on me...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: My family... We're Syndican immigrants settling in Eastside. Because of that, all my schoolmates... looked down on me.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: They mocked me, called me the filthy monster from the West District. They would pull pranks on me and make me run errands for them...
Have you ever told the teachers or your parents about that?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Um, yes...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: But... the teachers didn't care about the bickering among students. My parents cared a lot about me... but they would always tell me to be tolerant.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: My mom said if I didn't provoke these people, I could have a peaceful life in Eastside... So I listened to her...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: If it'd been just a usual prank, it would've been fine... but, but...
Lynn struggles to continue, as if it's already taken all of her accumulated courage to say just that.
It's alright, Lynn.
You're already brave enough to be able to say that.
You can take your time. I'll never mock you like they did.
Lynn's shoulders tense up anxiously. Finally, she goes on.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: On my birthday... I got a camera as my birthday gift. From then on... I've fallen in love with photography. It... makes me very happy.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Be, because... The tiny viewfinder can hold so many things. Among these things, the mockery and isolation... become so small that they're almost invisible...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Photography makes me... forget all my troubles.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Ah... I know... this is all nonsense... Sorry...
You don't need to apologize.
Not everyone can get over their trauma instantly. You've done nothing wrong.
Besides, isn't it a great thing to have a hobby? After all, it cheers you up.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: A great thing...?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Well, that's not what they thought...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: The Drifter Camp and Syndicate are my favorite photoshoot locations, though some people think they're dirty and messy... But personally, I find them a lot livelier than the cold sky-scrappers in Eastside.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: My schoolmates never approved of my photo-taking habit, and once they found out about my usual themes, things got even... more difficult...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I started wearing the helmet because... they said since I liked to shoot ugly things, I must have ugly eyes and poor eyesight. They said they didn't want to see my eyes...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: That useless things should be covered up, so they won't... become eyesores...
As she speaks, Lynn's voice starts to sound choked.
Then she pauses before she continues almost inaudibly.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: That's why I don't want to take off the helmet... I'm worried that I may become... even more of a nuisance.
...Trust me, no one will treat you like that here.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I'm sorry... Just think of it as a habit...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I only feel safe when I wear the helmet...
Lynn's account is painful and genuine. She's indeed exposed her past and laid it open before you.
But you know she's still hiding certain things from you.

You've looked into the personal details of the Eastside School Incident's victims. They include their usual behaviors and reputations.
You now have a different speculation about the cause of the incident.
You fumble in your pocket and hand something to Lynn. She takes it and tilts her head at you confusedly.
OwO gave me that. She called it a... candy of courage.
The questions I'm going to ask next may frighten you, but again... I hope you can trust me.
Lynn grips the candy in her palm and nods silently.
Recently, there have been quite a few similar campus incidents. One of them... happened at your school.
Lynn, have you heard of the Eastside School Incident?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Um... Yes... But I, I don't know the details...
Lynn is obviously getting evasive, dipping her head even lower unconsciously. You pretend not to notice that.
To ensure the stability of Eastside students' mental states and M-values, the Bureau lets the FAC conduct certain investigations on this.
Through the investigation, I've found that although the affected students have suffered serious injuries, they haven't received a lot of care and attention.
Do you know why?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: W-why...?
It's because... they have all been bullies at school.
It seems like what goes around does come around, and people find this outcome satisfying.
Many say that considering what they've done, they deserve to be stuck in the hospital for a while.
Do you think so too, Lynn?
Does that... make you less afraid?
Lynn is taken aback by the question. She stutters for a while, struggling to form a coherent sentence.
Suddenly, she curls up into a ball and makes a screeching, frightened cry.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I didn't... I didn't do it on purpose!!!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I'm sorry...! They, they started it first... I was just too scared... Sob...
Lynn presses down hard on her helmet, as if she's afraid someone may snatch it.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I'm a monster... I don't want to, don't want to hurt anyone...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I'm not sure what happened either. That beam of light just came out of my eye... I, I was terrified too...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Only when I wear the helmet... I won't...
Through her incoherent sentences, you confirm your speculation. A prank had gone wrong and Lynn lost control of her ability, accidentally hurting people.
But you didn't expect her to react so strongly.
Lynn! Calm down!
Shh... I know you're scared, but no one can hurt you anymore. And you can't hurt anyone anymore.
It's all in the past now...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: No, no, it's not...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I've already become a monster... Sob... I'm already one...
Lynn seems to be having a mental breakdown. The interrogation can't go on further.
Although you've deduced the general cause of the incident, you don't think the case can be considered closed yet.
The guilt and impulse in your heart motivate you... to do something more for this lost girl.
